nodes.name: MOF-on-MOF growth
nodes.procedure: 10 mL of a C₄H₆N₂ (0.1 mmol) aqueous solution was rapidly added to 10 mL of a Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O (0.5 mmol) aqueous solution that contained 0.1 mmol of RuCl₃·xH₂O and was stirred continuously for 1 h. Then, a washed carbon fiber cloth was placed in the above solution and grown for 10 h to obtain Ru-Co-MOF nanosheet arrays.

nodes.name: Ligand exchange
nodes.procedure: The Ru-Co-MOF nanosheet arrays were then soaked in a 0.005 M K3[Fe(CN)6] aqueous solution containing 1 g of PVP and heated at 90°C for 10 min to achieve rapid ligand exchange to obtain Ru-Co-MOF@CoFe-PBA nanosheet arrays.

nodes.evidence_snippet: the absorbed energy of Ru K marginal electrons transitioning from the 1s orbital to the outermost orbital in Ru-FeP-CoP/NPC (22112 eV) is between that of Ru foil (22110 eV) and RuO2 (22114 eV)... the two peaks obtained by the Fourier transform at 1.49 Å and 2.36 Å correspond to the Ru-P/O and Ru-Fe/Co bonds, with coordination numbers of 4.19 and 3.75, respectively... a robust Ru-Fe/Co bond signal was observed in Ru-FeP-CoP/NPC, demonstrating that Ru is doped in the lattice of FeP-CoP heterojunctions.
